title: Do You Really Swallow 8 Spiders a Year in Your Sleep? 🕷️ #shorts
description:
Did you believe it? Yes or no?
The famous "8 spiders a year" fact is a myth: there is no case on record, and to a spider you're a giant, hot, noisy monster.

Sources: Burke Museum (spider myths), Scientific American, Discover Magazine
